entries.title: DWG-0 owner authorization and engineering constraints

terms.access: Supplied directly by the repository owner for this work
terms.redistribution: Only this metadata and the resulting first-party governance may be published; the directive text is not redistributed
terms.notes: Authorization is limited to clean-room research in valle-design and is not a legal opinion, DWG license or certification

factsConsulted: Valle may research an original first-party DWG implementation inside this monorepo without a commercial codec
Product DWG availability must remain false throughout DWG-0
Restricted implementations, ambiguous sources and non-permissive licensing are prohibited
Work must use isolated branches, exact-SHA gates and no protection bypass
entries.reviewer: Codex preflight; owner is the authorizing party
entries.notes: No external implementation, SDK, specification or fixture was consulted for PR 1

entries.title: Existing Valle Design architecture, DWG boundary and signature preflight

terms.access: First-party repository controlled by the owner
terms.redistribution: Changes may remain in the same owner-controlled repository under its existing terms
terms.notes: Consulted as the authoritative pre-existing product and governance baseline

factsConsulted: ADR-0003 requires one canonical CadDocument and gates Rust/WASM
ADR-0004 and the product provider keep DWG unavailable
The web preflight recognizes AC10xx at offset zero and names nine known versions
Existing tests assert nativeSupport false, provider available false and .dwg dashboard rejection
The monorepo limits new TypeScript and JavaScript files to 800 lines
entries.notes: No third-party DWG facts were derived from the existing detector; its current behavior is only a first-party compatibility baseline
